ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat (ALPHV) Rust binary --access-token execution + pre-encryption shadow/backup wipe chain
ucs.description: Hunts the BlackCat/ALPHV-specific pre-encryption sequence: the Rust ransomware launched with its mandatory `--access-token <token> -p <path>` config-decrypt argument, paired with the textbook 'wipe-shadows-and-backups' chain (vssadmin delete shadows, wmic shadowcopy delete, bcdedit safeboot, net/sc stop on Veeam/SQL/BackupExec). Microsoft tracks BlackCat operators under Storm-0875 / DEV-0237; CrowdStrike calls them ALPHV SPIDER. The --access-token argument is BlackCat-unique — no other RaaS family requires runtime-supplied keying to decrypt its embedded config.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as bins dc(Processes.process_name) as chain_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.user!="*$") AND ((Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe Processes.process="*delete*shadows*" Processes.process="*all*" Processes.process="*quiet*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name=iisreset.exe Processes.process="*/stop*") OR ((Processes.process_name=net.exe OR Processes.process_name=net1.exe OR Processes.process_name=sc.exe) Processes.process="*stop*" (Processes.process="*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*SQLAgent*" OR Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*Acronis*" OR Processes.process="*VSS*")) OR Processes.process="*--access-token*") by Processes.dest Processes.user host _time span=30m | rename Processes.* as * | eval is_blackcat=if(match(cmds,"--access-token"),1,0) | where chain_count>=2 OR is_blackcat=1 | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows","/all","/quiet"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot" or ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled no" or ProcessCommandLine has "ignoreallfailures"))
     or (FileName =~ "iisreset.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/stop")
     or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSSQL","SQLAgent","Veeam","BackupExec","Acronis","VSS"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "--access-token" and ProcessCommandLine has " -p ")    // BlackCat Rust binary signature
| summarize Cmds=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20), Bins=make_set(FileName, 20),
            ChainCount=dcount(FileName), First=min(Timestamp), Last=max(Timestamp), EventCount=count()
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 30m)
| extend IsBlackCatToken = tostring(Cmds) has "--access-token"
| where ChainCount >= 2 or IsBlackCatToken
| order by Last desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where (Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and Cmd has_all ("delete","shadows","/all","/quiet"))
     or (Img endswith "\\wmic.exe" and Cmd has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (Img endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (Cmd has "safeboot" or Cmd has "recoveryenabled no" or Cmd has "ignoreallfailures"))
     or (Img endswith "\\iisreset.exe" and Cmd has "/stop")
     or ((Img endswith "\\net.exe" or Img endswith "\\net1.exe" or Img endswith "\\sc.exe") and Cmd has "stop" and Cmd has_any ("mssql","sqlagent","veeam","backupexec","acronis","vss"))
     or (Cmd has "--access-token" and Cmd has " -p ")
| summarize Cmds=make_set(CommandLine, 20), Bins=make_set(NewProcessName, 20),
            ChainCount=dcount(NewProcessName), First=min(TimeGenerated), Last=max(TimeGenerated), EventCount=count()
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| extend IsBlackCatToken = tostring(Cmds) has "--access-token"
| where ChainCount >= 2 or IsBlackCatToken
| order by Last desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat (ALPHV) Rust Ransomware Execution via --access-token
id: 8b2f1a9c-4d3e-4f1a-b6c2-blackcat-token-2026
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the BlackCat/ALPHV Rust ransomware binary, which requires a runtime --access-token argument plus the -p path flag to decrypt its embedded configuration and run. This argument shape is unique to BlackCat affiliates (tracked by Microsoft as Storm-0875 / DEV-0237 and by CrowdStrike as ALPHV SPIDER).
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-061a
author: detection-eng
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1027.013
  - threat.actor.alphv_spider
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '--access-token'
      - ' -p '
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\az.exe'
      - '\aws.exe'
      - '\gcloud.cmd'
  condition: selection_token and not filter_legit
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Rare developer/CI tooling that happens to take both flags; vet against the affiliate-build hash list
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 -@User:(*SYSTEM* OR *LOCAL\ SERVICE* OR *NETWORK\ SERVICE*) ((@CommandLine:(*"--access-token"* AND *" -p "*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* AND *"/all"* AND *"/quiet"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *ignoreallfailures*)) OR ((@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\sc.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\SC.EXE)) AND @CommandLine:*stop* AND @CommandLine:(*MSSQL* OR *Veeam* OR *VEEAM* OR *BackupExec* OR *Acronis* OR *SQLAgent*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (CommandLine=/--access-token\s+\S+/i CommandLine=/\s-p\s+/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows\s+\/all\s+\/quiet/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(safeboot|recoveryenabled\s+no|ignoreallfailures)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(net1?|sc)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/stop/i CommandLine=/(MSSQL|SQLAgent|Veeam|BackupExec|Acronis|VSS)/i)
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| case {
    CommandLine=/--access-token/i | is_blackcat_token := "1";
    *                              | is_blackcat_token := "0";
  }
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ count(as=events) | max(is_blackcat_token, as=token) | collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]) })
| (events >= 2 OR token = "1")
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The `--access-token <token> -p <path>` argument shape is a forensic fingerprint of BlackCat/ALPHV's Rust binary — it was introduced specifically to defeat sandboxing (you can't run BlackCat without the affiliate's token) and is not used by Conti/LockBit/Royal/Akira variants. Pairing it with BlackCat's signature shadow-wipe + backup-service-kill chain (documented in Microsoft DART, CISA AA23-061A,

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat affiliate exfiltration: rclone copy/sync to MEGA / cloud storage pre-encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the BlackCat affiliate-standard data theft step: rclone.exe (often dropped to C:\ProgramData, C:\Users\Public, or named svchost.exe/winlogon.exe for masquerading) invoked with `copy`/`sync` to a MEGA.nz, MEGA.co.nz, pCloud, Backblaze B2, or self-hosted SFTP remote. Microsoft tracks BlackCat exfil tooling (ExMatter + rclone) under Storm-0875 / Storm-1077; CrowdStrike attributes to ALPHV SPIDER. MEGA is the BlackCat leak-site staging platform of choice — every public BlackCat IR report from 2022-2024 (Mandiant M-Trends, Sygnia, Group-IB) lists rclone→MEGA as the canonical exfil channel.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_path) as path values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.user!="*$") AND (Processes.process_name=rclone.exe OR Processes.original_file_name=rclone.exe OR Processes.process="*rclone*") AND (Processes.process="*copy*" OR Processes.process="*sync*" OR Processes.process="*copyto*" OR Processes.process="*moveto*") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="*pcloud*" OR Processes.process="*backblazeb2*" OR Processes.process="*b2:*" OR Processes.process="*wasabi*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*") by Processes.dest Processes.user host | rename Processes.* as * | eval masquerade=if(match(path,"(?i)(programdata|users\\\\public|users\\\\\\S+\\\\downloads|temp|appdata\\\\local\\\\temp)\\\\"),1,0) | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let RcloneFlags = dynamic(["--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--config","--bwlimit","--checkers","--ignore-existing","--max-age","--min-age","--no-traverse"]);
let CloudTargets = dynamic(["mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","pcloud","backblazeb2","b2:","wasabi","dropbox","drive.google","gdrive:","sftp:","ftp:","webdav"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
    or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
    or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "rclone"
    or (ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneFlags) and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","copyto","moveto"))
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","copyto","moveto")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudTargets) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneFlags)
| extend Masqueraded = FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(ProgramData|Users\\Public|Users\\[^\\]+\\Downloads|Temp|AppData\\Local\\Temp|Intel|PerfLogs)\\"
      or (FileName !~ "rclone.exe" and ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
          OriginalFileName = ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName, Masqueraded
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RcloneFlags = dynamic(["--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--config","--bwlimit","--checkers","--ignore-existing","--max-age","--min-age","--no-traverse"]);
let CloudTargets = dynamic(["mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","pcloud","backblazeb2","b2:","wasabi","dropbox","drive.google","gdrive:","sftp:","ftp:","webdav"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Cmd = tolower(CommandLine), Img = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where Img endswith "\\rclone.exe"
    or (Cmd has_any (RcloneFlags) and Cmd has_any ("copy","sync","copyto","moveto"))
| where Cmd has_any ("copy","sync","copyto","moveto")
| where Cmd has_any (CloudTargets) or Cmd has_any (RcloneFlags)
| extend Masqueraded = Img matches regex @"\\(programdata|users\\public|users\\[^\\]+\\downloads|temp|appdata\\local\\temp|intel|perflogs)\\" and not(Img endswith "\\rclone.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Masqueraded
| order by TimeGenerated desc
